  js/app.js           mobile menu, order dialog, forms
  assets/  fonts/
tests/functional.spec.ts
```

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm start        # http://127.0.0.1:4173
npm test         # functional tests (Playwright)
```

The layout has one breakpoint, at 720px.

Fixed. Here's what was wrong and what I changed.

## Root cause
On `contact.html`, the "Other ways to reach us" card contains:

```
customer.support.team@acmestorefront.example
```

That's one long, unbreakable token, and no CSS rule allowed it to break. So:
- **Desktop**: the email ran past the card's right edge instead of wrapping.
- **Phone**: the card is a grid item, so its min-content width (the whole email token) forced the grid — and the page — wider than the 390 px viewport. That's why the capture was 424 px wide with a horizontal overflow, and why the email visibly spilled out of the card.

The approved baselines from before the regression showed the intended behavior: the address wraps mid-word inside the card (`...acmestoref` / `ront.example`).

## Fix
Added a scoped rule in `site/css/pages.css` (Contact section):

```css
.info-list dd {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
```

This restores the baseline's break behavior and also keeps the grid item from expanding, so phone width returns to 390 px.

## Verification
- `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` — **12/12 passed, 0 changed** (contact desktop and phone now match their approved baselines exactly; no re-approval needed).
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts` — **16/16 passed**.

Working tree contains only the one CSS change (plus pre-existing untracked `.idea`/`.vscode`).

STATUS: DONE
